title: Inbound reports
subtitle: Every email received on the reports inbox, with its processing status.
empty: No report received yet. Forward an email to the reports inbox to see it here.

assignDialog.title: Assign to a company
assignDialog.description: The report will be attached to this participation (and to every entity representing it, across all organizations), then processing resumes automatically. On an already processed report, the chosen participation is added to the previous ones.
assignDialog.relatedHint: These entities share the chosen participation’s website. On a sponsor domain they are often other vehicles — only tick the ones this report is really about.

related.hint: A company on the same domain exists in {{orgs}}, where this report is not attached — open “Attach as well” to add it.

detachDialog.title: Detach this report?
detachDialog.description: The report will be removed from {{name}}: it leaves its fiche, along with its files and the KPIs it filled in. The other attached participations keep theirs.
